Revision-checked structured editing for fresh Godot projects: GDScript, scenes, resources and input actions with Godot validation and rollback.
Persistent bounded milestone orchestration over existing ARCONT plans with budgets, receipts, revision checks and no silent retries.

Execute runtime experiments in the external ARCONT Runtime Lab repository; never inside ARCONT.
Operate revisioned Godot authoring, build and bounded playtest sessions in an external game repository.

Expose the same Godot authoring API over dependency-free MCP stdio for a connected local agent client.
Validate and stage production assets, review animation/sector/performance/TPS/audio evidence, and materialize verified native bundles in an external game repository.
Inspect, budget-check, derive collision policy, and stage local glTF/GLB candidates in an external game repository without network access.

readonly_write_attempt.error: external project write permission is required

goals: Prove a current MCP client can drive ARCONT through a persistent development session.
intent.title: MCP Acceptance

limitations: Static inventory only; no engine execution, scene rendering, asset semantic review, or performance claim.
Symlinks and generated/cache directories are skipped.
Inventory identifies local project files only; it does not infer copyright/license rights from file contents.
assets.inspect inventories local files only; provider-scoped network discovery is available separately through asset.public.* when project policy allows it.
Technical inventory does not establish artistic quality, runtime cost, rig correctness or target-platform suitability.

execution_semantics: one bounded ARCONT plan per execute request
failed plans stop and are recorded
session writes require exact session revision
plan capability allowlist must be a subset of session allowlist
project intent and ARCONT registry hashes are pinned for the session
